turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes.

With he, she and it, add **-s** to the verb: I work → she works. Some verbs take **-es**: watch → watches.

Exercise: Write the correct form (only the verb):
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays.
